::: {#fig-graph-real-function}

```{r}
#| label: graph-real-function-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "A parabola opening upward with its lowest point at the origin.",
  "Three points on the curve at horizontal positions -1, 0 and 2",
  "are marked and labeled with the pairs (-1, 1), (0, 0) and (2, 4)."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: graph-real-function-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
curve_data <- data.frame(a = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 201))
curve_data$value <- curve_data$a^2
marked <- data.frame(a = c(-1, 0, 2), value = c(-1, 0, 2)^2)
marked$label <- sprintf("(%d, %d)", marked$a, marked$value)

graph_real_function_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = curve_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value),
    colour = "#0072B2"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = marked,
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = marked,
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value, label = label),
    nudge_x = 0.35,
    nudge_y = 0.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Input, a", y = "Output, f(a) = a^2") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(graph_real_function_plot)
  )
} else {
  graph_real_function_plot
}
```

The [graph](#def-graph) of $f(a) = a^2$ on all of $\reals$ is the whole curve $y = a^2$, shown here for $-2.5 \le a \le 2.5$.
Each point of the curve is a pair $(a, f(a))$;
the three pairs from @exm-graph are marked.

:::
